messages:
Samir: Heads-up: two docs PRs conflict on parse-fallback patterns for function/tool calling. One uses an envelope always, the other uses compact parsed JSON when available. Which should be canonical in the tutorials?
Maria Chen: Tutorial should show compact for clarity. But include an interoperability section that explains the envelope and migration steps.
Jake L: Agreed. Compact for new users; envelope for compatibility. We need a small, language-agnostic pseudo-code snippet for the fallback handler.
Olivia P: I'll patch links (old invoke page) and rename API flag occurrences (`compact_response` -> `compact_mode`). Also will add a note about raw being a string in examples.
Samir: Proposed pseudo-code: `if parse_success: return parsed_obj else: return {"tool_name": t, "raw": raw_string}`. Keep examples showing `raw` as string and a note to `json.loads(raw)` for structured payloads.
Maria Chen: I'll draft the Python snippet + a tiny unit-test example and add a truncated-stream example to demonstrate fallback behavior.
Jake L: I'll add TS snippet and update the samples index to reference both snippets and the migration guide. Also include a one-liner metric for monitoring: `parse_fail_rate = failed_parses / total_calls`.
docs-bot: Reminder: PR #4821 will need rebasing due to flag rename.
Samir: Owners: Maria (Python + migration note), Jake (TS + index), Olivia (linkfix + flag rename), Samir (write fallback paragraph + envelope example). Target: thin PRs by EOD tomorrow.
Olivia P: tagging docs-owners and opening linkfix PR now. :thumbsup:
